name: ralphbot-monorepo
description: RALPHBOT - A quirky space-themed chatbot for RALPH creative agency

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run client:dev" "npm run server:dev" "npm run admin:dev"
scripts.build: npm run client:build && npm run server:build && npm run admin:build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.deploy: npm run build && echo '🚀 RALPHBOT ready for deployment!'

author: RALPH Creative Agency
